title: Simple Addition
description:
More adds to Minecraft by Datapacks.

body:
# 关于目前状况 Regarding the current situation of It
这个数据包，不再会进行更新。在我有充足的时间后，我会和我的一个朋友一起更新这个数据包的2代，名字暂定为Simple Vanilla Addition 2 简称为 SVA2 。很感谢来自Modrinth的网友们游览并下载我的数据包，尽管它只给我赚了0.01美金，折算人民币0.7元多。但是我没有下大功夫在它身上，也没有保持正常的更新。所以，感谢大家！2代出炉后的Modinth链接将第一时间展示于此！（NO THINGS）

This data pack will no longer be updated. After I have sufficient time, I will update the second generation of this data pack with a friend of mine, tentatively named Simple Vanilla Addition 2, abbreviated as SVA2. Thank you very much to the netizens from Modrinth for visiting and downloading my data pack, even though it only earned me 0.01 US dollars, which is equivalent to over 0.7 RMB. But I didn't put a lot of effort into it, nor did I keep it updated normally. So, thank you all! The Modinth link after the release of the 2nd generation will be displayed here for the first time! （NO THINGS）
# 中文
# 介绍
## 支持版本
- 1.16.2~1.16.5...... 仅Bug修复
- 1.20.1                ...... 稳定支持
- 1.21                    ...... 主要更新
- 其他                    ......  随机支持
## 都有些什么内容？
与其他实用模组不同，这个数据包可以在篝火上制作皮革，粗矿到锭（1.6+）等等！
接下来。我们将用这个数据包做更多的事情！来看一看吧~
# 如何下载？
一共有两种方式：
1.访问Modrinth下载页面。版本较少但比较稳定。
2.你也可以通过[Lanzou Cloud,Extraction code: 87my](https://1203rd.lanzouv.com/b00hpxd42b)下载。所有版本都有，包括开发中不稳定的版本。所以请小心安装。如因安装错误版本导致的问题概不负责。

**_·欢迎所有人Fork本数据包或基于本数据包制作，我不希望被用来商业目的！Fork或基于此所制作的数据包可以发布于任何（除了中国网易平台以外的）网站·_**

# ENGLISH
# Introduction
## applicable version
It is suitable for any version that supports packets, as its construction is very simple. As long as MOJANG does not change the underlying implementation of the packet, it can be supported.
## What are the contents?
Unlike other rotten flesh to leather mods, this datapack can to make leather over a campfire,raw ore to ingot(1.6+) and more! :)

Next. We will make more things with this datapack! Take a look to it~
# How to download?
Please go to the Modrinth download page.

**_·Important: Welcome everyone to Fork this data pack or create based on it. I do not want it to be used for commercial purposes! Fork or data packs created based on it can be published on any website (except for the Chinese NetEase platform)· Important·_**
